_comment: What the CLI cannot do yet, and what to do instead. Listed by 'mammoth capabilities' and 'mammoth schema find --unsupported'. Every workaround names a real command id (a unit test checks it). doc is a path in the bundled skill.

limitations.limitation: A dataset made from an uploaded file (or a URL) has no source to pull from, so an automation's run_data_retrieval or a schedule cannot refresh it.
limitations.instead: Upload each new file into the same dataset; its views re-run over the new rows. To make that automatic, connect the files' cloud storage and let an automation pull them.

limitations.limitation: No Mammoth server can list a project's schedules: 'schedule list' answers not_available.
limitations.instead: Read a schedule by its id, and use automations for recurring work: they can be listed.

limitations.limitation: The Mammoth MCP server cannot edit an existing pipeline task; it can only add tasks.
limitations.instead: Edit the task with the CLI: list the view's tasks, then replace the one you want.

workarounds.example: mammoth view task list VIEW_ID --input '{"dataset_id": DATASET_ID}'
mammoth view task update VIEW_ID TASK_ID --input '{"task_spec": {...}, "dataset_id": DATASET_ID}'

limitations.limitation: An API token reaches one project or every project in the workspace; a token for a chosen set of projects is not supported yet.
limitations.instead: Use a token for every project and pass --project on each command (or set the profile's project), or keep one profile per project-limited token.

limitations.limitation: When the backend cannot read the data packaged in a Tableau or Power BI workbook, 'dashboard import-workbook' builds the dashboard on generated sample rows (synthetic_data: true), not the workbook's data.
limitations.instead: Upload the real data as a file, then build the board from the real view (or have chat edit point the imported board at it), and delete the synthetic dataset.

workarounds.example: mammoth dashboard v3 generate --input '{"body": {"params": {"intent": "Rebuild the workbook's dashboard", "dataview_id": VIEW_ID}}}'
mammoth dashboard chat edit DASHBOARD_ID --input '{"body": {"params": {"prompt": "Use view VIEW_ID for every chart"}}}'
